decisions.reason: The glazed industrial sectional door sits within the firm's core industrial door range and survived the 2019 portfolio cleanup that removed the garage products, so it likely meets aspirations and needs no problemistic search.

Insulated glazed industrial doors match rising demand for energy efficiency in commercial buildings and fit the firm's thermal competence, so performance relative to aspiration is likely adequate and slack supports continued offering.
It has its own dedicated web page in both observed years, which signals management commitment and satisfactory results within the established industrial segment, so dropping it is unlikely.
